quote: Our wedding at Kaldan was nothing short of magical! The big lawn with the private beach provided a breathtaking backdrop for our ceremony. The team executed everything flawlessly, from the decor to the catering. Our guests couldn’t stop raving about the stunning venue and the seamless experience.
name: Meera Choudhury

quote: The hospitality at Kaldan is second to none. The staff is incredibly attentive, warm, and always ready to go the extra mile. From the moment we arrived, we felt valued and well taken care of. It’s the kind of service that leaves a lasting impression!
name: Natalie Teo

quote: Kaldan exceeded all our expectations! From the luxurious rooms to the incredible dining at Dhani restaurant, every moment was special. The big lawn with the private beach was stunning, and the wellness activities like kite flying and volleyball added so much fun to our stay. Truly a world-class experience!
name: Hannah Richter

quote: We are from Chennai, and people were communicating in Tamil rather than only Hindi-speaking staff. I am glad to see SCV connection for TV, again with a South Indian touch. As a mom of two, I was overwhelmed with baby food options, a big kudos that helped me relax. Being participative in my kid's birthday celebration truly made it a memorable one.
name: Ms Cebi Marrudhappan

quote: We thoroughly enjoyed our holidays here; it is a well-suited place for both adults and kids. Had a pleasant stay; the food was so delicious, and all the staff were kind and approachable. The property was very clean, and especially the swimming pool area; it was so neat, and the swimming pool guard was there to monitor the customer safety, which is highly appreciated. Overall, I highly recommend this place; we will definitely come back for the next visit.
name: Mr Sivakumar

quote: We are here for the first time to see all the reviews on social media, and one name we saw on social media everywhere was Miss. Srayashi, so we also met her here, and trust me, she is the best employee we have ever met in any 5-star hotel: the most helpful, humble, soft, and positive person.
name: Mr Anshul Goel

quote: It's a fantastic place, really loved it.
name: Mr Koushik

quote: A very nice place and well-maintained. I absolutely loved this place.
name: Priyanka Rai

quote: Kaldan redefined luxury for us! The rooms are beautifully appointed with elegant decor and state-of-the-art amenities. The attention to detail, from the cosy bedding to the stunning city views, made our stay truly special. It’s the perfect blend of comfort and sophistication!
name: Sarah L

quote: Dining at Dhani restaurant was an absolute delight! The fusion of traditional and contemporary flavours was exceptional, and every dish felt like a celebration of local cuisine. The ambience was warm and inviting, making it the perfect spot for a memorable meal. Highly recommend the seafood platter!
name: Vikram Nair

quote: Staying at Kaldan was such a refreshing experience! I loved the wellness activities, especially kite flying on the beach. It was so much fun and brought out the child in me. The serene beach setting made it even more enjoyable. A unique way to relax and unwind! One of the highlights of my stay at Kaldan was trying archery on the beach. It was a unique and thrilling experience, and the instructors were very patient and helpful. The tranquil beach setting added to the charm. Perfect for anyone looking to try something new!
name: Lily W
